info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Tungst Notebook Detail-v1-spec
info.description: This API allows users to create detailed entries for Tungst notebooks within the catalog. It serves as an essential tool for inventory management, enabling businesses to effectively manage their notebook product offerings. Developers and product managers can utilize this endpoint to streamline the addition of new notebook specifications, ensuring that all relevant details are recorded accurately. Typical consumers include catalog managers and inventory software developers aiming to enhance product detail visibility.

post.summary: Create details for a Tungst notebook.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create detailed information for a Tungst notebook. It accepts the necessary data in the request body to ensure the accurate representation of the notebook's attributes.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit details for a Tungst Notebook operation. It expects a JSON payload conforming to the specified schema.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the requested notebook details.

CreateCatalogTungstNotebookDetailRequest.title: Tungst Notebook Details Request Body

tungst_notebook_id.description: Unique identifier for the Tungst notebook.

requestedBy.description: The name of the person or entity requesting the operation.

quantity.description: The quantity of Tungst notebooks being requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request is a priority request.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the Tungst notebook.

CreateCatalogTungstNotebookDetailRequest.description: Schema representing the request body for the POST operation to create or update details for a Tungst notebook.

NotebookDimensions.title: Notebook Dimensions

width.description: The width of the notebook in specified units.

height.description: The height of the notebook in specified units.

unit.description: The unit of measurement used for the dimensions.

NotebookDimensions.description: Schema representing the dimensions of a Tungst notebook.

CreateCatalogTungstNotebookDetailRespons.description: The response schema for the successful processing of a notebook operation.

Pricing.title: Pricing Details

Pricing.description: Details regarding the pricing of the notebook operation.
